title: [Bug]: `code_execution_config` in `ReasoningAgent`
body:
### Describe the bug

The check here:
`if self._code_execution_config is not None:`

is not valid, as from `ConversableAgent`'s constructor:
`code_execution_config: Union[dict[str, Any], Literal[False]] = False`

so it defaults to `False` and not `None`.
